notes.title: Update v1.4 now live!
notes.content:
I'm excited to announce the biggest update thus far. Here's what's new!

1. New and separate endings for NORMAL and NIGHTMARE difficulty modes. 
2. Improvements to models and environment.
3. Gameplay enhancements, especially for NIGHTMARE mode. 
4. New achievements, including the CROWN OF DEATH winnable only by beating the game in all three difficulty modes. 
5. New punishment added!
6. Quality improved post processing!
7. Internal settings menu.
8. Rebuilt portions of the AI - (The game will play slightly different)
9. More balanced gameplay between difficulties
10. And many behind the scenes enhancements!

notes.title: Update v1.3 Live Now!
notes.content:
Hello,

I'm excited to announce that version 1.3 is available. I've listened to the input and this is what's come of it. 

Included in this build!

1. Additional models within the world
2. Improvements of assets.
3. Lighting improvements for the three different difficult settings
4. *Balancing of difficulty settings (This was the big one!)
5. Other bug fixes and improvements.

*Apparently, there was a bug that made Nightmare mode easier than Normal mode in some instances. This bug was an unexpected consequence of the AI working how it was designed to work prior to having difficulty levels. This has been fixed!

Happy gaming!

-Wanderingme
